captions.caption: A drone flies over a snow-covered slope near a ski lift pole.
The camera glides down a mountain towards a small village in the valley.
The drone accelerates down a snowy mountainside with patches of dirt.
The view transitions from snowy patches to green grass on the lower slope.
Flying under power lines or ski lift cables near a winding road.
A panoramic view of jagged, snow-capped mountains illuminated by the setting sun.
The drone glides over a high mountain ridge overlooking a deep valley.
Moving towards the sun as it dips behind distant snowy peaks.
A fast descent along a white, snow-covered mountain ridge.
The drone dives steeply down a smooth, snowy slope.
Approaching the edge of a snow-covered cliff at high speed.
The camera plunges down the side of a steep, snowy mountain.
Gliding swiftly over the undulating white terrain of a mountain peak.
Entering a wooded area with ski lift structures visible.
The drone flies directly through the frame of a ski lift chair.
Moving forward through a path of ski lift chairs surrounded by pine trees.
A high-speed flight through another set of chairlift poles and seats.
Continuing the flight along the ski lift line towards the mountains.
The drone passes under and through several ski lift chairs.
Exiting the forest area and moving towards the open mountain scenery.
The camera tilts down to show a dense green coniferous forest from above.
Flying low and fast over the tops of evergreen trees.
A close-up view of a pine tree top as the drone dives past it.
Gliding over a lush green forest on a steep mountain slope.
The drone descends further towards the green canopy of the forest.
Passing very close to the branches of pine trees during the flight.
Moving at high speed through the upper branches of a forest.
The camera captures a fleeting view of the valley through the trees.
A man in a jacket stands on a rocky ridge overlooking snowy mountains.
The man remains stationary as the drone begins to orbit him.
The drone circles around the man standing on the mountain peak.
Zooming out to reveal the man's small figure against the massive peaks.
A wide aerial shot of the man standing in a vast, snowy mountain landscape.
The drone moves away, highlighting the isolation of the man on the ridge.
A distant view of the man on the peak with the sun setting behind him.
The drone flies up a grassy and rocky hill towards a person standing at the top.
Reaching the summit of the hill where a person is standing.
The camera passes directly over the person on the hilltop.
Looking down at the person on the peak with snowy mountains in the background.
A vertical shot looking straight down at the person on the rocky summit.
The drone ascends to a high altitude, looking down at the mountain peak.
A rapid descent from a high altitude back towards the mountain surface.
Flying through a dense forest of tall, thin coniferous trees.
The camera points upward to show the sky through the tree branches.
Moving through the forest canopy with a view of white clouds.
The drone maneuvers between several tree trunks in the woods.
Emerging from the dense trees to a view of the valley and distant mountains.
Diving down over a green forest towards a village nestled in the valley.
A top-down view of the dense green tree tops in the forest.
Flying low and fast over the canopy of evergreen trees.
A wide shot of the snowy mountain range during the golden hour.
The sun sets behind the jagged peaks of the mountains.
The sky is filled with warm colors over the snow-covered landscape.
Gliding slowly over the snowy mountain terrain as the light fades.
A wide-angle view of a mountain pass with a road winding through it.
A man is silhouetted against the sunset while standing on a mountain ridge.
The camera zooms in on the man's silhouette as he looks at the view.
The man stands still, taking in the vast mountain panorama.
The drone orbits the silhouetted man during the sunset.
A final shot of the man on the peak under a colorful evening sky.
